verdict.rationale: Live, round-the-clock support is a fair question for a business banking platform, but the evidence never documents live or 24/7 customer support channels. The only related item is a third-party review praising 'helpful customer support', which says nothing about availability or live contact. Self-service actions such as freezing a card in the app are an adjacent feature, not live support.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
